privateMutationInvariants.notPublicContract: mutation of internal Clang AST nodes, lookup formatter implementation

privateMetadataHelpers.replacement: PublicFrontendSnapshotTests annotation source cases + existing configuration strict conversion tests
privateMetadataHelpers.scope: literal attribute preservation remains tested; direct mutation/formatting calls to internal helper objects are deliberately retired rather than made public

resourceBoundary.replacement: WorkerAssetProvisioningTests public bundled-resource preparation + WorkerExecutionCaptureTests public execution identity
resourceBoundary.preserved: hash verification, reuse, missing/extra files, malformed archive paths, file/directory conflicts, cancellation, output ownership; private arbitrary-byte extraction is not a public seam

workerIdentity.preserved: manifest encoding, BOM, complete runtime/host closure, altered bytes at equal length/timestamp, missing/extra/duplicate/escaped/reserved artifacts, cancellation
workerIdentity.scope: private lazy-extra enumeration timing no longer defines test access; generic path/publication fault boundaries test late input changes

isolatedHistoricalSdkDependency: TestExpressions.TestInitListExpression retains its original body; the GUID declaration-only input is now repository-owned guiddef.h, independent of SDK version/path. SDK discovery and standard-library parsing remain in public target tests.
